combo_box.name: combobox grid mode
combo_box.tool_tip: Grid ruler: World, Local, or Reference; choices depend on the selection

panel.label: General
panel.name: General
panel.panel.string: You can't modify this object across a region boundary
You can't modify these objects across a region boundary
You must select entire object to set permissions

line_editor.name: Object Name
line_editor.tool_tip: The name is limited to 63 characters. Longer prim names are cut short. Names can only consist of printable characters found in the ASCII-7 character set, except the vertical bar.

line_editor.name: Object Description
line_editor.tool_tip: The prim description is limited to 127 bytes; longer strings are truncated.

button.label: Set group
button.name: button set group
button.tool_tip: Choose a group to share this object's permissions

check_box.label: Share with group
check_box.name: checkbox share with group
check_box.tool_tip: Allow all members of the set group to share your modify permissions for this object. You must Deed to enable role restrictions.

button.label: Deed
button.name: button deed
button.tool_tip: Deeding gives this item away with next owner permissions. Group shared objects can be deeded by a group officer.

combo_box.name: sale type
combo_box.tool_tip: Select whether purchaser will receive a copy, copy of the content or item itself.

check_box.label: Show in search
check_box.name: search_check
check_box.tool_tip: Let people see this object in search results

check_box.label: Locked
check_box.name: checkbox locked
check_box.tool_tip: Prevents object from being moved or deleted. Frequently useful during building to avoid unintended edits.

check_box.label: Physical
check_box.name: Physical Checkbox Ctrl
check_box.tool_tip: Allows object to be pushed and affected by gravity

check_box.label: Temporary
check_box.name: Temporary Checkbox Ctrl
check_box.tool_tip: Causes object to be deleted 1 minute after creation

check_box.label: Phantom
check_box.name: Phantom Checkbox Ctrl
check_box.tool_tip: Causes object to not collide with other objects or avatars

button.label: Paste
button.name: paste_pos
button.tool_tip: Apply the last copied position values

button.label: Paste
button.name: paste_size
button.tool_tip: Apply the last copied size values

button.label: Paste
button.name: paste_rot
button.tool_tip: Apply the last copied rotation values

check_box.label: Mirror
check_box.name: sculpt mirror control
check_box.tool_tip: Flips sculpted prim along the X axis

check_box.label: Inside-out
check_box.name: sculpt invert control
check_box.tool_tip: Inverts the sculpted prims normals, making it appear inside-out

panel.name: features_scroll_body
panel.text: Select only one primitive to edit features.

check_box.label: Animated Mesh
check_box.name: Animated Mesh Checkbox Ctrl
check_box.tool_tip: Allows rigged mesh objects to be animated independently

check_box.label: Flexible Path
check_box.name: Flexible1D Checkbox Ctrl
check_box.tool_tip: Allows object to flex about the Z axis (Client-side only)

texture_picker.name: light texture control
texture_picker.tool_tip: Click to choose a projection image

check_box.label: Reflection Probe
check_box.name: Reflection Probe
check_box.tool_tip: Adjusts how objects within this volume receive reflections when PBR is enabled

check_box.label: Dynamic
check_box.name: Probe Dynamic
check_box.tool_tip: When enabled, Avatars will appear in reflections within this probe's influence volume.

check_box.label: Show owners
check_box.name: checkbox show owners
check_box.tool_tip:
Colorize the parcels according to the type of owner:
Green = Your land Aqua = Your group's land Red = Owned by others Yellow = For sale Purple = For auction Grey = Public
